missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Дивизия' stays in the nominative case as the feminine subject stationed at the border. 'Танковая' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Дивизию' is the accusative direct object of 'построил'. 'Всю' is the agreeing feminine accusative form.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Дивизии' is the genitive form showing which division the soldiers belong to. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Дивизии' is the dative case marking the recipient of the order. The dative answers 'to whom' the command was given.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Дивизией' is the instrumental case required by the verb 'командовать'. 'Первой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О дивизии' uses the prepositional form 'дивизии' after 'о' to express talking about the division. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В дивизии' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to show where he serves. 'Горной' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Дивизии' takes the genitive singular after 'три', as numerals two through four require. A core numeral pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Дивизий' is the genitive plural after 'несколько'. The soft stem yields a zero ending with the inserted и. A key quantity pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Дивизии' is the nominative plural subject. 'Все' agrees in the plural, and 'готовы' is the short plural predicate adjective.
